import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if k == 0:
        ret = pow(p, p-1, MOD)
    elif k == 1:
        ret = pow(p, p, MOD)
    else:
        l = 1
        cur = k
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            l += 1
        ret = pow(p, (p-1)//l, MOD)
    
    print(ret)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
